brief: Trial NCT02522598 (Vivozon, phase 2). What is its status and stated reason, and were results ever posted?

findings.claim: Trial NCT02522598 has an overall status of COMPLETED.
findings.notes: Confirmed via snapshot and live ClinicalTrials.gov record.

findings.claim: Trial NCT02522598 has a blank why_stopped reason since it was completed rather than stopped.
findings.notes: Registry records why_stopped as null and why_stopped_category as blank.

findings.claim: Results were never posted for trial NCT02522598 on ClinicalTrials.gov.
findings.notes: results_posted is false and results_first_post_date is null.

findings.claim: Trial NCT02522598 started in August 2015, with primary completion and completion in February 2016, and enrolled 38 participants.
Trial NCT02522598 has a results_due_date of January 31, 2017 and is overdue (3565 days late).
findings.notes: Calculated days late in the snapshot data.

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT02522598'
